headline: Maui Liquor Board Fines 3 Bars for Serving Minors

meeting.body: Maui Liquor Board Fines 3 Bars for Serving Minors
meeting.summary: The Liquor Control Adjudication Board met Thursday, June 4.
meeting.recap: The Liquor Control Adjudication Board met Thursday, June 4.[[0:00:35]] The board postponed a case against a brewing company, likely to July or August.[[0:06:16]] The prosecutor said a bartender there served a cocktail to an underage decoy from the liquor department.[[0:11:01]] A motion to suspend part of one fine failed with two no votes.[[0:22:30]] A motion for full $1,000 fines on both counts failed, three votes to two.[[0:25:48]] A surf cafe and lounge pleaded no contest to three counts.[[0:31:59]] The prosecutor said a cafe worker checked a decoy's ID and still served her a cocktail.[[0:33:31]] The board voted unanimously to fine the cafe $1,000 on each of two counts, with $250 suspended.[[0:47:13]] The board voted unanimously to fine the restaurant $1,000 on each of two counts, with $250 suspended.[[1:04:21]] The liquor director asked that the checks be called minor decoy operations, not stings.[[1:05:27]]
meeting.next: The chair said the brewing company case would be squeezed in in July or set in August. The cafe will be told when its payment is due.

moments.q: A board member: "It's two questions and prevent this from happening."
Cafe's lawyer on a later decoy check: "the person was not served."
Restaurant's lawyer: "No minor actually consumed the alcohol."
